custom_logic_notes: Four selectable entry strategies: HFT Tick Momentum (tick-level, no bar guard), Candlestick Engulfing (bar guard), RSI Reversal (bar guard, crosses back from OB/OS zones), EMA Crossover (bar guard). Three selectable martingale types: Classic Multiplier, Multiplier with Sum, Sum with Initial. On trade close via OnTradeTransaction: martingale adjusts lot size. On reversal signal: closes opposite position first, then opens new position on next tick. Pending orders are trailed (updated) every InpPendingUpdateInterval seconds. Daily profit limit and drawdown protection with server-time or custom UTC time window. Trade cooldown between consecutive trades. Stops level safety check for SL/TP placement.
python_conversion_notes: Martingale with margin-dependent lot capping requires margin simulation. HFT Tick Momentum strategy requires tick data. Pending order trailing updates every N seconds need timer simulation. OnTradeTransaction equivalent must be implemented for martingale lot adjustment on deal close. Session management with per-day time ranges and close-at-session-end adds complexity. Risk management reset logic depends on server vs UTC time mode. Multiple entry strategies are user-selectable, so conversion must handle all four. RSI reversal uses cross-back (previous bar in zone, current bar out of zone), not simple level breach.
